title: Protect or unlock PDF

userPassword.title: Password to open
userPassword.$comment: Collected by the form and moved into secrets.userPassword by the core. The adapter rejects it as a param.
userPassword.description: Needed to open the file. It can't be recovered if lost.

ownerPassword.title: Permissions password (optional)
ownerPassword.$comment: Moved into secrets.ownerPassword by the core. If absent, a random one is generated and never stored or shown.
ownerPassword.description: Lets someone change the permissions later. If you leave it empty, a random one is used and never shown.

permissions.title: Allow
permissions.description: PDF viewers honor these voluntarily; they are not real access control.

confirmRights.title: I have the right to remove these restrictions
confirmRights.description: Required to unlock a file that has only a permissions password.

$comment: Passwords are entered in password widgets and travel only in the request's secrets, never in params (spec section 7.3).
